text:
Anna (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — need to lock QBR scorecards & MDF runway for CloudRange SI + VectorGrid HW slots. Can we get final numbers by EOD Mon?
Mike (Finance): Can you post the current MDF pool and committed vs available? I only have last week's snapshot.
Jess (Partner Ops): Current live sheet: https://corp.sheets/partnerships/qbr-mdf-runway (view-only). Committed: $420k. Unallocated: $180k. Note: some credits are pending legal sign-off.
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks Jess. @Mike — what flexibility do we have to reallocate from Marketplace pilot credits to SI onboarding this quarter?
Mike (Finance): We can shift up to $75k if Marketplace OKs moving 2 pilot listings to self-serve rebate. Need sign-off from Marketplace lead.
Devon (Marketplace): Noted. We can convert 2 pilot listings to rebate if they meet listing checklist. That frees ~60-75k depending on coupon depth.
Leo (SI PM): If we get the MDF reallocated, we can accelerate SI integration to finish two critical adapters by end of month. That unlocks an announced joint case study.
Jess (Partner Ops): Proposed prioritization (short):
- Tier 1 SI (CloudRange): $100k commit to push to gold onboarding
- VectorGrid (HW partner): $60k for co-marketing + launch event credits
- Marketplace pilot conversion: -$60k (reclaim)
Net delta: -$20k required from general pool.
Anna (Partnerships): OK — @Mike can we cover the -$20k from contingency?
Mike (Finance): Contingency balance is $30k. Approve assuming legal sign-offs done by Fri.
Anna (Partnerships): Great. Action items:
- Jess: update scorecard metrics to reflect new MDF allocation + add 'go/no-go' flag for legal — due Thu
- Devon: confirm 2 marketplace listings that can convert — due Wed
- Leo: draft SI adapter milestone plan + demo date — due Fri
- @Mike: confirm final transfer and notify treasury — due Mon EOD
Jess (Partner Ops): I'll add a 'scorecard delta' column and ping legal channel for the sign-offs.
Devon (Marketplace): Will triage listings today, will DM results.
Leo (SI PM): Demo target week of 2211114 — holding a placeholder in calendar.
Alexa-bot: Calendar invite created for "QBR MDF allocation review" on 2211112275.ics — attendees: Anna, Mike, Jess, Devon, Leo
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks team. If we can hit these, we can include CloudRange + VectorGrid as highlights in the QBR narrative. :sparkles:
Mike (Finance): FYI — I'll mark the ledger but won't move funds until legal confirms. Ping me if legal stalls.
Jess (Partner Ops): Noted. I'll post an updated scorecard snapshot in this thread when done.
Anna (Partnerships): Perfect — short sync Thu 9am to confirm. /cc @here
